deployments_detail.use: Grid-V AI-powered visualization system monitoring power systems 24/7 to detect fire, smoke and foreign objects (drones, cranes) near transmission lines and substations

Grid-V (Grid Visualisation): AI-powered platform integrating ~3,000 sensor points and cameras for 24/7 real-time monitoring of substations, switchgear, overhead cables and transmission lines. AI detects environmental risks and abnormalities (fire, smoke, foreign objects like drones/kites/cranes) and monitors worker safety PPE compliance, issuing severity-graded alerts to engineers.

AI-based network load forecasting: AI algorithms analyse climate and load-consumption data every 30 minutes to generate precise forecasts for network loads across multiple areas, supporting real-time smart-grid operation rather than relying on historical data.

Smart-meter in-house AI analytics: CLP uses proprietary AI analytics to monitor residential smart-meter data (hourly usage), delivering personalised consumption alerts and estimated bills via the CLP One App.

AutoGrid Flex flexibility management platform: multi-year deal to deploy ML/AI for real-time optimisation of distributed energy resources (DER management, solar/battery, load forecasting, peak shaving, demand-side management), including microgrid optimisation at Hong Kong Science and Technology Park and demand-response via EnergyAustralia. [AutoGrid (Flex platform)]
Machine-learning algorithms to enhance the efficiency of power generation assets and to forecast power generation, enabling energy supply to be balanced as renewable sources are integrated.

Customer-service AI agent-assist bots (MasterChat platform): Trainer Bot (AI-driven service training/consistency), Communicator Bot (drafts clear consistent customer communications), and Knowledge Bot (surfaces trusted answers/guidance in seconds) supporting frontline customer-service agents.
Power Kid: customer-facing AI chatbot on CLP Hong Kong's website providing 24/7 support for general enquiries, service information and energy-saving tips.
VoltAI: CLP's in-house generative-AI platform / concierge for employees, letting staff explore and deploy AI safely to work smarter, faster and more securely as part of CLP's Digital strategy.
Product Configurator Bot: AI assistant to deliver needs-based product recommendations helping customers choose energy-saving appliances; pilot planned for 2026.
